Article by Kumar Published on: 12:03 pm, 22 October 2026

It is already known that the United States is frequently researching for mysterious and otherworldly creatures in the vicinity. Now they appear to have witnessed something very similar at the famous in United States and Mexico border.

In a set of pictures that are now going viral, we get to see a mysterious looking creature, which was captured on camera at the border region.

A mysterious creature captured in camera-trap images near the US-Mexico border has sparked speculation after UFO investigator Jaime Maussan claimed it could be an unknown predator unlike any commonly found on Earth.

Maussan alleges that the animal has been killing and carrying away chickens, roosters and rabbits in Mexico’s Valley of Juárez, a rural farming area along the Rio Grande.

The first picture of this creature has been released, and it has immediately grabbed all the attention on social media as it looks like a giant lizard. But the colour complexion and the entire appearance looks very spooky as the pale look is unlike anything that we’ve seen thus far.

But at the same time, there is no verified and independent evidence confirming the creature is an unknown species, extraterrestrial, or responsible for the reported animal killings. So further research is expected to be done to establish the origin of this creature.
